body: A multilingual embedding model for dense, sparse, and multi-vector text retrieval.
plain_description: **Find and rank relevant information across languages and long documents.** Generate dense, sparse, or multi-vector text representations for search. Supports more than 100 languages and inputs up to 8,192 tokens.
technical_description: BGE-M3 is a multilingual embedding model supporting dense retrieval, sparse lexical matching, and multi-vector retrieval. It handles more than 100 languages and sequences up to 8,192 tokens. The README provides examples for generating embeddings and scoring text pairs, and describes fine-tuning options.
title: BGE-M3
